lessons.title: Lesson 11: I ask Allah
paragraphs: We learned that Allah hears what we say...
What do we need when we are thirsty?...
And Allah is the One who gave us water...
And we can ask Allah for what we need...
When we make dua to Allah...
We ask Him for what we need...
And we also ask our families to give us water...
Allah has given us families who help us...
Now let's choose something we need...
You can ask Allah for what you chose...
Then we ask Him for what we need...

lessons.title: Lesson 12: I ask Allah to keep me safe
paragraphs: Let's remember going out with our families...
We hold the hand of a grown-up in our family...
Can you remember who holds your hand?...
You can say who you remember...
And we ask Allah to keep us safe...
That means to protect us from things that can hurt us...
I ask Allah to protect me...
That means I ask Allah to keep me safe...
I ask Allah to protect me...
Now let's think of our families...
And we want Allah to keep them safe too...
Let's make dua for ourselves and for them...
O Allah, keep me and my family safe...
We stay close to our families...
And ask Allah to protect us...

lessons.title: Lesson 13: I thank Allah
paragraphs: Let's think of a food we like...
What food did you think of?...
This food is something Allah gives us...
Allah is the One who gave us water...
And made plants grow for us...
And gave us our bodies too...
When we remember what Allah has given us...
One way we thank Him is to say...
We say it while we remember Allah's blessings...
Our eyes that we see with?...
Or our ears that we hear with?...
You can say what you chose...
And when someone in our family prepares food for us...
We thank them for their help...
And praise Allah, who gave us the food...
This is how we remember Allah in our day...

lessons.title: Lesson 14: I love Allah
paragraphs: Let's think of a sound we like to hear...
Or the voice of someone in our family?...
What sound did you think of?...
Allah gave us our ears that we hear with...
And our eyes that we see with...
And He made us and gave us what we need...
We remember Allah, who gave them to us...
We want to do what He loves...
Let's think of a little way to help...
We could put our toys back where they belong...
That makes it easier for our families to tidy our home...
And you can name another way to help...
And we want to do what He loves...

lessons.title: Lesson 15: We worship Allah alone
paragraphs: And when we remember what He has given us...
We say, "All praise is for Allah..."
A dua we can make to Allah...
Or a blessing we can praise Him for...
And praise Him and thank Him...
Because we love Him and want to obey Him...
That means doing what He tells us to do...
And not doing what He tells us not to do...
These are ways of worshiping Allah...
And Allah is the only One we worship...
He is the One who made us and gave us what we need...
And no one is like Him...
Prayer is also a way we worship Allah...
And we will learn about it together...

lessons.title: Lesson 16: Muslims pray to Allah
paragraphs: Have you seen someone in your family praying?...
You can tell me what you remember...
In prayer they remember Allah and make dua to Him...
Prayer has words and actions that we learn...
Standing is a part of prayer...
And we learn its other actions and words with our families...
We pray to Allah, who made us...
And we love Him and worship Him...
We can also ask someone in our family to teach us...
I would like to learn to pray with you...

lessons.title: Lesson 17: When I do something wrong, I turn back to Allah
paragraphs: When they have not said we can take it...
Then we realize we did something wrong...
And wish we had not done it...
So what can we do now?...
We stop doing what is wrong...
And give the toy back to our friend...
And we do not want to take other people's things...
And we ask Allah to forgive us...
We stop doing what is wrong...
And put right what we did...
And ask Allah to forgive us...
This is how we turn back to Allah...
This is called turning back to Allah...
Allah accepts it when someone turns back to Him...
If we want to play with our friend's toy again...
What do we do before we take it?...
And we play with it if they say we can...
